evidence: Swap test fails: the frame (pale grey-green ground, white bordered 4px cards, one bold sans, one dark-green filled button, square thumbnail + title + meta + pill badge cards) would carry a seed library, a community-hall room booking or a toy library unchanged once words are swapped (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png).

Every card thumbnail is the same wrench glyph on a pale green square (all 10 cards, find page, every width/theme) - the one place imagery could show 'the drill with two batteries' is a repeated placeholder.

Category-guess fails: 'community / sustainability service' predicts green accent on off-white with rounded-ish cards and a line icon; this is what is on screen. The identity mark is a stock wrench icon beside the name set in bold body text.
Similar-prompt fails: a brief for 'a neighbourhood seed library reservation, phone first' would land on the same card grid, same green, same calendar with session labels.

What is product-bound is content and copy: real tool names with specs ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries'), deposits on every card, 'Available from Sat 10 Oct', session calendar with 'Open' tags on Wed/Sat (tool default 1280), 'Bring your membership card and the deposit', done page 'A volunteer will check the tool with you'. These sit on a portable frame (anchor 1).

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: identical wrench icon in a flat pale-green box on all 10 tool cards (find, all widths and themes).

Browser-default controls in the filter panel: native date input showing 'yyyy/mm/dd' with the system calendar glyph, and a native select with the system chevron, top-misaligned with the date field (items-ladder-3m/filters-open/1280-light.png).
Identity is only the name in bold body-size text next to a stock wrench glyph in the masthead; nothing else on any page carries the library's own look.
No focal point beyond the H1 on find, basket, confirm and done; sections are a heading plus a list or a form.
Bands stop short: on basket and done at 1280 the white footer band ends and a flat grey empty band fills the rest of the viewport (basket default 1280-light, done default 1280-light).

Half-empty layouts at wide widths: confirm form and 'What happens next' box occupy the left 55% leaving the right side empty; basket shows one full-width session card above a row of five cramped ones.
Headings differ from body only in size and weight; one family, no typographic moment.
Tool names truncated with ellipsis on the find page at 375 ('Cordless drill 18 V, co...'), so the two drills are indistinguishable on a phone.
evidence: First viewport of find at 1280 light: heading 'Find a tool', a grey paragraph, a full-width search field and the start of a uniform 2-column card grid; nothing to look at besides text and repeated wrench glyphs.
Dark theme (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-dark.png) is orderly but equally bare; available badges lose their tinted pill while 'later' badges keep a grey pill.
Tool page is the richest screen (spec list, calendar with Open tags) but its calendar is a grid of identical white boxes and the sticky bar overlaps it in captures.
Done page (done default 1280-light): a bordered key-value table, a bordered text box and an outline button; no confirmation moment, no visual sign the reservation is made beyond the H1.
It is clean and careful in copy, so not unappealing; but it reads as a default form/listing, so plain.
